title: A staff-name search on a bin-split Part History entry keeps every bin row
custom_preconds: QA env https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com (S2 shop), location Staging Heavy Duty. Logged in as Admin. (Admin has Part Library & Inventory > Delete.) A part at Staging Heavy Duty whose Part History has a "Received ..." entry split across two bins (e.g. receive the QAPL-T2 line of the open purchase order with part of the quantity in each of two of QAPL-T2's bins). Note the Staff name on that entry and both bin names.
custom_steps:
1. Open the part's Part History (row history icon).
  2. Type the Staff name of the "Received ..." entry in the Part History search.
  3. Retype the Staff name in lower case.
  4. Replace the search with the first bin's name.
  5. Replace the search with the second bin's name.
  6. Clear the search.
custom_expected:
1. The "Received ..." entry shows one row per bin (two bin rows), with Staff, Date and Time.
  2. The "Received ..." entry is listed with both of its bin rows (a Staff match keeps every bin row); that staff member's other entries are listed too.
  3. Same result: case does not matter.
  4. The "Received ..." entry shows only the first bin's row (other entries show only if their text names that bin).
  5. The "Received ..." entry shows only the second bin's row.
  6. Every entry is back; the "Received ..." entry shows both bin rows.
